SYN-POL-IMG-01.title: Advanced imaging of the lumbar spine (synthetic)

criteria.C1: Low back pain with radicular symptoms for at least 6 weeks
criteria.C2: Failure of at least 6 weeks of conservative care (physical therapy or supervised exercise, and medication)
criteria.C3: Or any red-flag finding: progressive motor deficit, bowel/bladder dysfunction, suspected infection or malignancy

criteria.C1: Clinical suspicion of obstructive sleep apnea documented by a validated screening score
criteria.C2: Home sleep apnea testing is contraindicated or was technically inadequate
criteria.C3: Significant comorbidity such as moderate-to-severe heart failure or neuromuscular disease

criteria.C1: Sleep study showing AHI of 15 or more, or AHI 5-14 with documented symptoms
criteria.C2: Face-to-face clinical evaluation before the sleep study
